visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraved illustration depicting a street scene at night. In the foreground, a man in a dark suit is captured in a dynamic, lunging pose, stepping over a man who is crouched or kneeling on the ground. To the left, a man in a long coat and top hat stands leaning against a stone wall with a decorative corbel. In the background, other figures are visible, including a woman and a man walking away, set against a backdrop of multi-story urban buildings.
